title: Holy Spirit
definition: The Holy Spirit is the third Person of the Trinity, fully God, sent by the Father and the Son to glorify Christ, apply redemption, indwell believers, and empower holy living.
summary: The Spirit is not an impersonal force but the personal divine Helper. He convicts, regenerates, sanctifies, teaches, comforts, empowers, and leads believers into truth.
christFocus: The Spirit keeps believers looking to Christ. He does not draw attention away from Jesus but makes Christ known, trusted, loved, and obeyed.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The Holy Spirit is personal and divine.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: He applies the work of Christ to the believer.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: The Christian life is lived by dependence on the Spirit, not by fleshly strength.
